issues.title: Object.hasOwn(proxy, prop) is not reactive
issues.author: Rich-Harris
issues.body:
### Describe the bug Given a state proxy `s`, `prop in s` is reactive but `Object.hasOwn(s, prop)` is not: ```svelte

{'x' in s}

{Object.hasOwn(s, 'y')}

``` ### Reproduction [link](https://svelte.dev/playground/hello-world?version=5.57.0#H4sIAAAAAAAAE32MQWqEQBBFr1IUARVE96YVsstuDhCzaO0a0klP2Vg1UWm8e3BCSAIh2_ff-wnZXggbfKQQJlimOTjIyXklV2CJZx9IsHlKqFs8vANg-VU9xFjJOwU92GCF_uLjxEqsgg0aGWcfteu510AKAi3ciVqlPO3Ffc-m_jbYDFfViWHiMfjxrU15AW0HUq3Qgs5X2jvrHKym_hS7f5LtV7L9SHo2sUvZmoFnkN3U8fiJXToNrzRq9WLltHAuJWRbVtx2LFFpVWxuj88lqvVh8eywOdsgtH8Ak5NLLVcBAAA) ### Logs ```shell ``` ### System Info ```shell latest ``` ### Severity annoyance
